title: All Video Downloader & Home
summary: Download videos easily and organize your phone with a smart launcher
description:
All Video Downloader & Home is a powerful app that allows you to download videos from supported websites.

With the built-in browser, you can easily detect and download videos.

Key Features

Fast Video Downloader

Download videos from supported websites

Built-in browser to detect videos automatically

Fast download speed

Download multiple videos at once

Watch videos offline anytime

Download Manager

Track download progress

Manage downloaded videos easily

Simple & Easy to Use

Modern user interface

Fast performance

Lightweight and efficient

How It Works

Open the built-in browser

Visit a supported website

Play the video

Tap the download button

Smart Home Launcher

Clean and simple home screen

Quick access to all installed apps

Fast app search

Smooth and lightweight launcher experience

Easy app organization

Important Notice

This application supports downloading videos only from websites that allow downloading. Users must ensure they have permission to download the content.

Downloading videos from YouTube or other copyrighted platforms is not supported.
